svg.title: CIF Doctor around PostMR and ReadySet
svg.desc: The existing model-preparation path runs from source dictionaries and an MR model through optional Coot mutation, prepared inputs, ReadySet and effective dictionary selection to existing PostMR gates and refinement. Dashed read-only audit branches inspect mutation sources, frozen source and runtime inputs, and the selected effective bundle. Explicit external linked candidates and native diagnostics check site definitions and selected proxies. Bounded source-declared ring comparisons retain all raw bond differences. Native site IDs and component-list metadata loops preserve reader contracts. Returned Cedar 09 native checks preserve formal-charge and terminal-chemistry review limits. A completed terminal-source review records installed parameters and a canonical hydroxyl control. Selected modified-terminal candidates and explicit 5CM preparation pass installed projected-definition and unaffected-proxy checks; formal-charge readback remains unavailable. A separate graph-selected outgoing-oxygen candidate layer preserves existing dictionaries and modifiers. Returned Cedar 14 clears all four outgoing-hydrogen findings and passes installed projected-definition, captured-baseline replay and exact modifier-ID checks; source, charge and achieved-geometry limits remain open. A separate captured Cartesian review measures simple-bond distances, angles and ordered chirality volumes. Nominal deviations are descriptive; native residuals, deferred geometry and absolute stereochemistry remain unassessed. Returned Cedar 15 source-versus-model and coordinate-lineage comparisons expose earlier model distortions. Cedar 16 freezes original stages and parses saved Coot declarations without execution; controlled legacy replay reproduces the damaging coordinate-copy operation for captured transitions. Other MR/raw/source problems remain open. A separate graph-selected fragment candidate transports the entire raw base through a preserved sugar frame. Returned Cedar 17 passes native mechanics while retaining unresolved and worsened pairing contacts. A separate source/effective recovery requires exact original hashes and supported source graphs, then whole-component generation and linked/native gates at fixed coordinates before a fragment trial. Returned Cedar 18 verifies source-preserving generation and both native phases; full scientific qualification stays open. A separate fixed-definition geometry trial records native stopping, gradients and full-precision versus PDB round-trip evidence; returned Cedar 19 optimization reaches its explicit iteration cap. Identity mapping preserves original PDB records across native reordering, and Cedar 20 reuses saved endpoints. Its native reread preserves identities/definitions and activates extra distance-filtered hydrogen bonds. A read-only reload audit retains the changed proxy set and original REVIEW separately from saved fixed-manager endpoint equivalence. A separate explicit NARestraints pair/stack compiler preserves existing edits and tests native membership at two saved coordinate sets; both returned native cases pass exact membership checks while geometry qualification stays open. Production PostMR is unchanged. Returned Cedar 22 verifies a separate bounded geometry trial under this policy: exact initial manager matching and all 17 native PDB readback checks pass. The objective decreases, while a line-search error and remaining pairing/local-angle strain retain scientific review. Returned Cedar 23 matches the fixed manager and sources, and localizes stable sampled gradient disagreement to native parallelity at both precisions. Independent plane calculations and public accumulation-loop bounds reproduce the saved evidence; Cedar 24 supplies installed per-proxy confirmation. Returned Cedar 24 confirms an installed plane-gradient accumulation defect: sampled individual-restraint derivatives agree while second-plane contributions are omitted in all captured and tilted-control orders. The installed loop-bound model reproduces the accumulation arrays exactly. Saved-data recombination explains all prior sampled mismatches. Cedar 25 implements an explicit NASolve-local correction using complete original single-restraint gradients and unchanged native energies. Its return passes both endpoints but retains six initial-coordinate directions. An independent model of normal-orientation sign handling reproduces the remaining gradient. Returned Cedar 26 uses each plane as the first plane in both orders and passes all sampled global, per-plane and rotated-control derivatives with unchanged native energies. Cedar 27 supplies a bounded trial from the original initial coordinates, gated by exact qualified source/gradient matching and followed by endpoint derivatives and native PDB mechanics. Returned Cedar 27 passes all 17 mechanics checks and 336 sampled endpoint directions while retaining the 1,000-iteration limit. Its target falls 28.72% and still descends; Cedar 28 supplies a bounded saved-full-precision coordinate continuation with fresh optimizer history, exact start-gradient/target matching and repeated endpoint/native mechanics gates. Returned Cedar 28 passes all 17 mechanics and 336 sampled endpoint directions, with another 3.64% target decrease. The cumulative 2,000 iterations retain the limit and the same three distance/ten angle reviews. Cedar 29 supplies a separate graph-selected base-orientation audit: temporary rigid-base rotations under the same fixed policy, with full/rounded category slopes, fresh rotational derivatives, source-angle context and repeat/additivity/periodic controls. Returned Cedar 29 passes all 96 sampled rotation directions; zero degrees is the lowest independent coarse sample at each site, without a minimum claim. Cedar 30 supplies separate graph-only source numerical recovery with exact chemical comparisons and explicit source-coordinate seed provenance. Returned Cedar 30 stops before generation on external coordinate-tag case. Cedar 31 preserves canonical CCD Cartn spelling and adds an explicit public PDU graph/NARestraints compiler control. PDU retains the propynyl triple bond; existing AT and both stacking-order compiler checks pass. Returned Cedar 31 separates a DP missing-alias reader failure from a PDU optimizer/restart crash after nonconvergence; neither produces a dictionary. Cedar 32 supplies missing alias metadata and anchored installed-source/read-only input checks before another generation. Returned Cedar 32 passes PDU read-only input and exposes DP reader-dialect review. Cedar 33 projects declared chemistry into a separate reader input and supplies an opt-in explicit bounded step trial after installed options-parser/source proof. Unknown atom metadata and nonconvergence remain explicit. Returned Cedar 33 passes both readers, stops DP in preparatory chirality handling and writes a nonconverged PDU candidate. Cedar 34 separately compares source/generated signed hands and omitted R/S metadata, summarizes the printed energy trace and probes installed reader markers plus its isolated chiral constructor without another generation. Absolute CIP assignment remains open. Returned Cedar 34 reproduces the DP assertion and passes PDU known markers. Native constructor internals include local chiral-template minimization, so the legacy NOT_RUN flag does not instrument those operations. Cedar 35 preserves source comp_list reader routing and equal coordinate aliases, then records selected native parser dispatch and raw atom/bond/charge/coordinate readback without requesting a constructor or generation. Returned Cedar 35 stops at the internal temporary graph path before native parsing. Cedar 36 resolves only the owned temporary directory and preserves the failed capsule for the same parser retry. Returned Cedar 36 passes PDU raw inventory and exposes DP monomer bond-token case fallback plus omitted formal charges, while signed markers survive. Cedar 37 translates declared order vocabulary and separately controls explicit source-charge population on a temporary parsed component under exact graph/coordinate and pinned API proofs, retaining raw findings and recorded before/after graph and stereo fields. Returned Cedar 37 preserves declared orders and passes isolated source-charge controls. Cedar 38 screens graph-selected triple lengths, linear angles, active proxy membership and linear-axis torsions in fixed isolated PDU and 5PC controls, comparing installed lookup, captured installed CIF and the saved PDU candidate. The two 5PC role records remain ambiguous. Returned Cedar 38 finds no component in both default monomer lookups and confirms active triple/linear terms plus six torsion reviews for the supplied PDU dictionary at fixed source seeds. Cedar 39 separates installed CCD chemistry from numerical libraries, records direct/canonical lookup context, compares declarations/descriptor text and captures route-helper/dispatcher source without running ReadySet, a constructor, generation or optimization. Returned Cedar 39 confirms installed CCD declarations and raw readers while all four numerical monomer lookups remain missing. Cedar 40 captures the literal ReadySet entrypoint and bounded import text without execution, and records only the native CCD filename/SMILES accessor selection. Descriptor membership is not mapped-graph or numerical restraint qualification. Returned Cedar 40 verifies both CACTVS selections and 24 static sources. Returned Cedar 41 records failed preparatory file-input builder calls: leaked wrapper PHIL options stop nested eLBOW parsing. Its surviving CIFs are unchanged source copies and native triple checks do not run. Cedar 42 keeps explicit ReadySet API arguments out of process options, matching the captured native entrypoint, preserves original builder kwargs, and reports worker/native/output outcomes separately. Failed source-copy and fixed-model evidence replays before another bounded isolated attempt. Returned C42 completes both controls and passes generated/native triple targets, retaining six dictionary and three active heavy-atom linear-axis torsions each, phosphate charge/hydrogen changes and 5PC plane review. C43 rebuilds the exact isolated managers and evaluates fixed native torsion kernels/gradients at saved source and generated full/rounded coordinates with central differences, repeats, reversal and nonchemical collinearity controls. Returned C43 passes sampled derivatives but retains near-collinear conditioning review. C44 prepares separate candidates omitting only torsions containing explicit triple-bond graph angles declared as 180 degrees, preserving all other parsed values. Fresh native original/candidate comparisons must show only six definition-row and three heavy-proxy omissions each, with triple targets and every unrelated term intact. Returned C44 passes both exact native comparisons and triple screens, with dihedral counts 28 to 25 and all unrelated fields intact. C45 rebuilds both managers and compares original/candidate energies and gradients at identical saved source/full/rounded coordinates. Deltas must equal saved omitted-torsion contributions; other families, additivity, repeats, static signatures and source hashes remain fixed. Candidate full/dihedral derivatives are sampled with six steps and graph-selected directions under a 2000-evaluation/180-second bound. Norm decreases are descriptive, not required. Returned C45 passes arithmetic and omitted-term deltas, retaining two 5PC count-only reviews with unchanged repeated energies/gradients. C46 captures actual native pair identities, parameters, single/container contributions and cache state. Changed pairs must contribute exactly zero before a separate settled-cache retry of unchanged strict criteria; pair identities and function parameters remain monitored. Old failures stay visible. Returned C46 passes all six cache/strict cases and 48 independently replayed pair transitions, with exactly zero changed-pair contributions; charge/stereo/plane and scaffold review remain open. C47 separately tests the source-native reader, explicit charge transfer, exact native class promotion and original Chiralise handoff for DP and both public controls, recording complete snapshots and source-relative handedness. Local chiral-template optimization may occur internally; no complete builder, dictionary generation or absolute CIP validation is requested. Returned C47 records three exceptions after source graph/charge gates pass: the diagnostic omitted the native CCTBX backend prerequisite. The old route gate reflects absent exception metadata, not proven route mutation. C48 replays those failures, restarts original source bytes, checks the installed reader same-object SetCCTBX(True) then Chiralise sequence and captures backend methods, flags and exact unchanged state before invoking the original constructor. Returned C48 completes all three constructors and backend/inventory gates while retaining source-relative sugar-hand reviews. All-basis endpoint checks add a DP C4-prime finding and mixed-basis 5PC C4-prime evidence without an absolute CIP verdict. C49 compares fresh unobserved/observed constructors with selected-source method-boundary wrappers, complete states and local atom order/sharing evidence, unchanged native calls, restored methods and bounded budgets. Maintained replay reports first observed hand reviews across all neighbor bases, not a causal defect. Returned C49 completes six constructors with exact fresh and previous endpoint matches; all 84 calls replay. Hand reviews remain, and DP native marker continuity fails while separate volume-sign metadata survives. Local parent snapshots can mix temporary frames. C50 adds selected native coordinate getter/setter and manager chirality-proxy observations, maps actual local index bases to source names, and reports post-optimizer index transfers before a repair. Original metadata/hand gates and native targets stay fixed. Returned C50 passes all 18 getter/nine setter checks and exact fresh/previous endpoint comparisons, with nine sorted transfers matched; legacy local-order proxy origins remain reviewed. A sorted-name hypothesis resolves public target signs but retains DP C1-prime review. C51 records native restraint dictionary atom keys, stored coordinates and original returned vectors/parameters under selected producer/factory source proofs. Named restraint order and actual local getter order remain separate; original gates/targets are preserved. ATL adds a separate public bridged-sugar/four-centre and existing NARestraints compiler control, without native construction or scaffold changes. Repeat differences and native nondeterminism remain explicit; C51 returned empty atom-key observations; C52 records actual integer keys/link positions. C52 returns all nine bindings PASS and eight source target signs agree. Returned C53 passes all setup/cache checks and nine source target signs. Returned C54 completes all three full builders, preserving explicit charges and nine finished source-relative configurations. PDU reports nonconvergence; DP/5PC stopping is unreported. DP loses one unoriented phosphate volume term, while fixed sugar definitions match. C55 reuses the saved dictionaries at source and generated coordinates for exact isolated native usability, complete tetrahedral coverage and finite repeatable energies/gradients, then feeds verified evidence to the automatic decision core within the isolated generated-candidate pool. Returned C55 supplies six completed native interpretations and twelve finite, repeatable energy/gradient evaluations. V1 rejects Cartesian roundoff and native period-zero/zero-ESD constant rows. Corrected v2 uses a 1e-12 A roundtrip bound, exact constant-container targets/weights and signed torsion permutations, passing all six cases and three isolated decisions with notes. Returned C56 verifies all six saved passes and three continue decisions without new native calls. C57 restores only explicit source DNA group/type headers in separate candidates and tests isolated native metadata, fixed covalent proxies and full targets/named gradients at the same coordinate cases, with verified-original fallback. Existing native classification already says DNA despite generic written groups. Returned C57 verifies all six native equivalence cases and three source-metadata selections with notes; twelve finite evaluations repeat exactly. C58 uses passed hash-bound isolated evidence to prepare source-graph site modifiers in separate three-residue DNA controls with fixed backbone/flanking coordinates and a rigid graph-selected base graft. One canonical and three modified native workers must preserve exact two-link targets, projected/heavy restraints, phosphate tetrahedral coverage and unaffected flanking mechanics, under the existing PHIL namespace adapter. Returned C58 verifies all 2940 payloads and passes all three linked controls after four completed native workers and eight finite repeatable fixed evaluations; formal-charge readback remains unsupported without contradictions. C59 separately tests DP at B:4 in the preserved 877-atom/43-site full NARestraints manager: replace only selected dictionary/modifier requests, preserve shared definitions and unselected bytes, rebuild the original baseline, and require all 38 links, projected heavy restraints and every explicit pairing/stacking term. Returned C59 verifies all 3097 payloads and both complete native workers: twelve baseline checks pass, and the candidate has 67 passed checks plus one unsupported charge readback. The separate automatic decision selects qualified_candidate with notes, retaining all 877 atoms, 43 sites, 38 links and explicit NARestraints terms. C60 supplies one bounded geometry trial under the replacement manager: a fresh initial corrected-gradient audit, strictly matched prior general plane proof, a new covalent constraint signature, at most 1000 iterations with unchanged native optimizer/termination mechanics, endpoint derivatives at full and rounded precision, exact native readback and serialization/source-hash checks, zero fixed-hand sign conflicts in both full and fresh rounded geometry, and endpoint targets no worse than the new initial target under the same objective. The report uses cif-qualified-scaffold-geometry-trial-v1, preserves native cif-fixed-na-corrected-geometry-trial-v1, and applies cif-qualified-scaffold-geometry-choice-v1 through select_scaffold_geometry. Retain the usable endpoint or verified C59 initial model automatically, including absent endpoints; nonconvergence, pucker and residual outliers alone are notes, without mandatory additional cycles. Returned C60 verifies all 3300 payloads and unchanged C59 parent, passes the fresh initial and both endpoint sampled derivative cases, all 17 exact native readback checks and all eight selection checks. It selects qualified_geometry_endpoint with notes: target 2671.029230 to 2508.431084 and gradient norm 1507.689322 to 50.997383, while preserving NOT_CONVERGED_LIMIT at 1000 iterations and 1033 calls. The written PDB has separate target 2511.569430 and gradient norm 878.690317; both geometries retain zero fixed-hand conflicts and three bond/nine angle nominal outliers. C61 stages the exact selected written model, 19 CIFs and 14 PHILs into a portable relative hash-bound runtime bundle with inherited activation evidence and notes. A generic resolver and ordinary cif-doctor assess --bundle reader consume it, retaining the initial model in activation evidence and adding a plain-language solution_report with selection/stopping notes and PDF status planned; one fresh staged native readback must reproduce the qualified rounded manager and NARestraints policy. Returned C61 verifies all 3406 payloads, unchanged C60 parent, exact model/19 CIFs/14 PHILs and all 15 fresh native readback checks, with two finite repeated evaluations of the same serialized objective. The ordinary 33-input assessment remains REVIEW with preserved selection/stopping notes and PDF planned. Returned C62 completes Coot 1.3.3 but all DP/PDU/5PC sites retain their whole raw site for unmatched OP3; no rigid transport is exercised. C63 adds ordinary internal-phosphate context: inherited CONECT and unchanged atoms authorize selected serial normalization, then an unchanged sanitizer proves selected OP3 deletions on a discarded parent-scaffold shadow. Only proved deletions pass to original raw coordinates before existing proper whole-base transport and the same sanitizer recheck. Frozen phosphate intent, curated placements and unsupported/bridged whole-raw-site fallback remain. Fresh controls use the same ordinary API with one Coot process/600 seconds; the saved-C62 context study is not fresh native evidence. Returned C63 separately passes all three fresh whole-base transports, exactly three internal OP3 deletions, 69 selected serial normalizations and unchanged final phosphate sanitation, preserving geometry within 0.0011 A. C64 reads back that exact constructed model and a canonical reference in two bounded Phenix interpretations, with existing source-qualified site modifiers, exact canonical backbone links, heavy-atom proxies, triple targets and fixed repeat evaluations. Different-objective energies are not ranked; native secondary-structure guessing stays disabled and NAR policy compilation remains separate. Returned C64 completes both native workers and passes active PDU/5PC triple targets. Six display-padding reviews resolve through structured atom identities: C65 compares all 3148 unaffected terms with exact ordered parameters, labels bound to indices and unique identities, without new native calls. Original C64 reviews remain preserved; scientific and production integration remain separate. Completed composition is observed; inspect-only remains unobserved. Narrow opaque diagnostic-backup transport preserves legacy timestamped bytes and names without relaxing scientific paths. ATL stays independent public graph/eligibility only. Automatic acquisition/repair adoption, generic NAR compilation, production checkpoints/refinement, PDF rendering and scientific qualification remain separate. Persistent local reuse of usable numerical repairs is required planned integration, separate from site and coordinate validation. Bundle summary native_selection denotes VERIFIED_SOURCE_CAPTURE with no new native selection executed; historical receipts remain unchanged. No AutoMR run or checkpoint is fabricated without observations or an ordinary PostMR report. The automatic fallback decision core and PostMR summary are implemented; production orchestration/adoption/PDF integration remain planned. Original models and chemical state stay preserved. Native optimizer kernels remain uninstrumented; the full-scaffold candidate is a separate diagnostic, with no production integration. Equivalent operational role aliases now compile once, with descriptive columns excluded and a registered canonical synthetic partner preferred; conflicting mappings remain blocked. 5PC already has C-sheet roles, so no NAR workbook or release changes. JSON receipts preserve findings; no coordinate repair or stitching is performed by this audit layer.
svg.text: CIF Doctor: evidence around model preparation
Assessment + decision policy · exact inputs · preserved provenance

g.text: Checks: graph, numerical consistency and bonded-atom coordinate degeneracy
PASS / REVIEW / INVALID / UNASSESSED describe the checked evidence.
Usable nonconvergence: continue with notes; no student CIF approval.
C63 whole-base construction PASS; C64 tests native readback.
